meta.note: Times are Belize local exactly as BEL printed them. 'ALL' for feeder or zone is a real value, not missing data.

outages.purpose: BEL dispatched to investigate the cause of an unplanned power outage to restore power supply as soon as possible
outages.raw_text:
Load Center: San Ignacio.
Feeder: 2.
Zone: All.
Areas to be affected: areas along the George Price Highway from Santa Elena to Esperanza, through to Unitedville, surrounding areas of Cristo Rey and San Antonio Road, Billy White, Baking Pot Road, Duck Run 1, Duck Run 2, Duck Run 3, Chiquibul Road from the junction of Georgeville to 7 Miles Progresso, and the area around BEL Kontiki Substation and Trench Town area.
Outage type: Unscheduled.  
Purpose of outage: BEL dispatched to investigate the cause of an unplanned power outage to restore power supply as soon as possible.
